items.rationale: Frost fracture of a fitting inside the building is covered under 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9. Priced at the level of the near-identical references.
A connection element renewed with the fractured fitting is covered under 7.1.9. Priced at the reference level.
Labour on the covered fitting renewal is covered under 7.1.7(f). Priced at about 100/hr x 3 hrs.
Consumables can in principle be covered under 7.1.7(e). However, this line was never indemnified in the references, so the probability is low and the value small.
One attendance per undertaking is covered under 7.1.11. Priced at the WD-2026 reference level of about 40.
Leak location is covered under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 (cap 2,500). Case 32 put the price at 15-20.

items.description: Facade damage from internal water escape, frozen
items.rationale: Under 2.4.3 an external surface damaged by escaping water that then froze is covered without the optional frost peril. This generic repair line has no close price reference.
Taking off the damaged render is covered under 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(a). Case 32 showed roughly 160 per pc.
Re-forming the substrate of the affected area is covered under 7.1.7(c). Priced from case 32 at about 38.
This is unspecified work on the covered facade repair. Under 9.6 an item that cannot be allocated may be declined, so both coverage and price are uncertain.
Substrate preparation is covered under 7.1.7(c). Priced from case 32 at about 31.
The coats the finish system requires are covered under 7.1.7(d). Priced from case 32 at about 59.
Drying needed before the repair can proceed is covered under 7.1.7(c), especially for a saturated wall. Priced from case 32 at about 254.
Priming of the affected area is covered under 7.1.7(c)/(d). Priced from case 32 at about 117.
Labour on the covered facade work is covered under 7.1.7(f). Priced at about 55/hr x 5 hrs.
This appears to be an admin or processing charge pricing no work, which 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude. It was never indemnified in the references.
